# Third-party notices for bundled Cua Driver 0.30.1 Windows executables

This notice collection covers a conservative normal/build dependency closure for cua-driver.exe, cua-driver-uia.exe and cua-cursor-theme.exe, using the fixed upstream Cargo.lock and x86_64-pc-windows-msvc manifests. Development dependencies and other platforms are excluded where the manifest predicate is explicit. Build-time and conservatively included components are retained to preserve notices. This is not an assertion that every listed component is linked into every executable. No package code was executed.

The optional cua-perception extension, detector model weights and ONNX Runtime are not bundled. The upstream Cua repository license does not relicense its dependencies. Individual license expressions and original package license/notice texts follow. Archive SHA-256 checks match the fixed Cargo.lock.
